sentences.content: I'm Wu Binbin. My family often helps at the children's centre.
sentences.english: I'm Wu Binbin . My family often helps at the children's centre
sentences.chinese: 我是Wu Binbin。我的家人经常在儿童中心帮忙。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: My dad is a doctor. He is kind. He often helps the children there.
sentences.english: My dad is a doctor . He is kind . He often helps the children there
sentences.chinese: 我的爸爸是一名医生。他很善良。他经常帮助那里的孩子们。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: My mum is a cook. She cooks nice food there.
sentences.english: My mum is a cook . She cooks nice food there
sentences.chinese: 我的妈妈是位厨师。她在那里烹饪美味的食物。

wordDetails.definition: cook（第三人称单数）: 烹饪

sentences.content: My uncle is a PE teacher. He plays football with the children.
sentences.english: My uncle is a PE teacher . He plays football with the children
sentences.chinese: 我的叔叔是一名体育老师。他和孩子们一起踢足球。

sentences.content: My sister Xinxin and I play games with them. All my family help make our community better.
sentences.english: My sister Xinxin and I play games with them . All my family help make our community better
sentences.chinese: 我和妹妹Xinxin与他们一起玩游戏。我们全家都在为改善社区贡献力量。

sentences.content: Three Chinese children help in the zoo.
sentences.english: Three Chinese children help in the zoo
sentences.chinese: 三名中国儿童在动物园帮忙。

sentences.content: There are fish, dolphins and big elephants too.
sentences.english: There are fish , dolphins and big elephants too
sentences.chinese: 这里有鱼、海豚，还有大象。

sentences.content: They take a lot of photos. The photos are really cool!
sentences.english: They take a lot of photos . The photos are really cool !
sentences.chinese: 他们拍了很多照片。这些照片真的很酷！

sentences.content: Tick, tock. Time for lunch. Oh! What delicious food!
sentences.english: Tick , tock . Time for lunch . Oh ! What delicious food !
sentences.chinese: 滴答，滴答。午饭时间到。哦！多美味的食物啊！

sentences.content: How can you help your community? Make a plan.
sentences.english: How can you help your community ? Make a plan
sentences.chinese: 你该如何帮助你的社区？制定一个计划。
